name: @workspace/db
_comment: No `push` script by design. src/schema/index.ts is intentionally empty — the API server owns the real schema (db/migrations/*.sql) and migrates at startup. A drizzle-kit push would diff that empty schema against the live database and offer to DROP every table; with --force it wipes silently. See .agents/memory/post-merge-drizzle-trap.md. Only reintroduce a push script if the real schema actually moves into this package.
